scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
KeekeekeeKeheheh.
This is amazing!
The results are extraordinary!!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻。
太棒了！
结果简直超乎想象！！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Using my skills in this distant
land was unexpected...
Keheheh... The lord of palace
was quite accomodating.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
没想到我竟然能在这遥远的地方施展我的技艺...
嘻嘻嘻...那位宫殿的主人倒是挺通情达理的。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oops, I better be careful...
If the guild finds out my
location, stupid Myster will
get mad at me. Kehehehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
哎呀，我得小心点...
要是被公会发现我的行踪，那个笨蛋米斯特肯定会生气的。嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
What? Wanna say something?
If you are here for tourism,
enjoy your day off, then go back to your hometown.
Keekeekee... Or else,
I will let you taste my acid bottle...!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
怎么？有话想说？
如果你只是来旅游，享受你的假期，那就回你的家乡去吧。
嘻嘻嘻嘻...否则，
我就让你尝尝我的盐酸瓶...！

scripts.text: Please, excuse me
scripts.translation: 请原谅我

scripts.text: Do you need help?
scripts.translation: 您需要帮忙吗？

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh... Did you hear
what I said? It would be
better to forget...
Keekeekeekeekee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻...你听到我说的话了吗？最好忘掉...
嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Help, eh?...
Now that I think about it...
I need some items right now...
Keeheeheekeehee...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
帮忙，是吗？...
现在想想...
我现在正好需要一些材料...
嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Sir Laspuchin needs some
enchant stones for an experiment.
I will use it efficiently...
Do you have them now?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
拉斯普钦大人需要一些强化石来做实验。
我会高效利用它们的...
你现在有吗？

scripts.text: Nope
scripts.translation: 没有

scripts.text: I got some
scripts.translation: 我有

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
If you bring 8 of one kind of
enchant stones, I will change it
to a better one...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
那么，去找8颗同一种类的石头吧。
如果你带来8颗同一种类的强化石，我会把它变成更好的...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Then, find 8 stones of one kind.
not the round gemstones but
enchant stones.
If you bring the wrong stones,
I will throw a flame bottle!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
那么，去找8颗同一种类的石头吧。
不是那种圆形的宝石原石，而是强化石。
如果你带错了石头，
我就扔一瓶火焰瓶！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
把石头带给我，奴隶~！！
并且遵守你的承诺！嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Uh-huh, what did you bring?
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嗯哼，你带了什么来？

scripts.text: Mystic Frozen
scripts.translation: 水灵原石

scripts.text: Great Nature
scripts.translation: 土灵原石

scripts.text: Flame Heart
scripts.translation: 火灵原石

scripts.text: Rough Wind
scripts.translation: 风灵原石

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
I will take 8 of them and
give you an enchant stone.
How's that sound?
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
我会拿走其中8颗，然后给你一颗强化石。
怎么样？
嘻嘻嘻.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
You can't help Laspuchin with just a couple
of enchant stones... I said 8!
Bring me just 8 stones!
Keheheh.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
就几颗强化石可帮不了拉斯普钦大人...我说了要8颗！
只给我带8颗石头来！
嘻嘻嘻.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh~ Check your pockets
before you tell me
how foolish you are.....
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻~ 在你告诉我你有多愚蠢之前，
先检查一下你的口袋吧.....

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
HeeHee, what do you want? Choose one!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻，你想要什么？选一个！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Oh, well.
Don't tell anyone about my location...
Keheheh...after all, you did promise~
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
哦，好吧。
不要告诉任何人我的位置...
嘻嘻嘻...毕竟，你可是答应过的~

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Kehhehheh, You know something?
I don't have many of those
so I'm going to take ^0000FF12^000000 of yours, okay?
Of course, it is okay.
It is an honor to help Laspuchin!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻，你知道吗？
我那里没有多少那种东西，
所以我要拿走你的^0000FF12^000000个，好吗？
当然，这是没问题的。
能帮助拉斯普钦大人是你的荣幸！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh, You know something.
I don't have many of these so
I can't just get 8 of yours.
If you want to change them to Rough Wind,
bring me 4 more stones. 8 + 4 = 12...
Requires ^0000FF12^000000 stones.
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻，你知道吗。
我那里没有这么多，
所以不能直接拿走你8个。
如果你想把它们换成风灵原石，
再给我带4个石头来。8 + 4 = 12...
需要^0000FF12^000000个石头。

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Keheheh! You've chosen a good one!
Use it well...
Bring me other stones if you have them!
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
嘻嘻嘻！你选了一个好东西！
好好使用它...
如果你还有别的石头，就带给我吧！

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Kehheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
给我带石头来，宝箱巨鳄小兵~！！
并且要遵守你的承诺！嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones, slave~!!
And keep your promise! Keheheheheh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
给我带石头来，宝箱巨鳄小兵~！！
并且要遵守你的承诺！嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...

scripts.text:
[Laspuchin Gregory]
Bring me stones! You said you are going to help me!
Keep your promises! Kehehehkehkeh...
scripts.translation:
[拉斯普钦·格雷戈里]
给我带石头来！你说过要帮我的！
要遵守承诺！嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻嘻...
